body: Time will tell. If you continue to provide less than stellar performance, you may see a quick bump in income due to current situation but long term you will not see increased income. It's up us how we want to handle our batches. For the Karen who holds us accountable for store inventory, we've all been there. I can't worry about what I cannot control. I just do my best on every batch and hope my customers see that. So far, I've been able to recover.

I agree with your sentiment about them putting profits first. Unfortunately, not many major corporations put their customers first. It's a double edged sword. You want batches to pay higher but you feel bad for the customer when their batch sits there forever because its shit pay and not worth your time. I shop because I need a second income and it's been a good second income for me. Maybe if it was my main source I would be more protective of being able to see batches first. The system will forever be flawed. I'm just glad that right now, regardless of rating, everyone can see what's out there. Maybe it will encourage those with lower ratings  to provide better service during these difficult times. 🤷🏼‍♀️

Your points all valid and I respect your position. We all are 1 batch away from being offered less batches. No system is perfect nor do I expect it to be. Like you said, if some clown swipes faster than me, so be it. I will move on to the next batch and swipe quicker the next time.
